newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end higher but off early highs.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end higher but off early highs.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished slightly higher on Tuesday but rumours of political unrest prompted individuals to square their positions, wiping out early gains, dealers said.
They said the market was likely to open mixed on Wednesday as major investors would remain cautious on political uncertainty.

The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index rose 1.17 points, or 0.08 percent, to end at 1,434.51 after soaring to 1,449.91 at noon. Gainers led losers 126 to 90. Turnover rose to 36.74 million shares from 26.79 million on Monday.
